target_module: origins/server/shops.ts (proposed new module; not checked against the Frankendom tree)

data_fields.name: buy_back_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.95 (BuyCostMod default, applied to the sell payout)

data_fields.name: stackable_quantity_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: item StackSize (per item, read from item data, no fixed constant)

data_fields.name: non_stackable_quantity
data_fields.donor_constant: donor charges requested quantity; sketch clamps to 1

best_idea: The vendor buy is a server transaction: the client names a stock slot and quantity, the server looks up the line, recomputes the price from base price and a charisma-style percent, takes coin from one wallet, and only then grants the item.
decision_why: Take the slot lookup, server-computed price and single wallet, which fit server-verified transactions and one ledger; check bag room before the charge and clamp non-stackable quantity to one, because the donor takes coin first and does not refund on a full bag (14261 vs 14298); keep the CHA/faction curve optional and off by default because the addendum's rulings name no charisma or faction stat.
acceptance: With the curve off, buying a 1000-copper line costs 1050 copper whatever price the request carries; a buy with a full bag is refused and the wallet is unchanged; a quantity of 5 on a non-stackable line is clamped to one item and charged for one.
